initialFindings: Staging validator did not verify coverage IDs against the canonical registry context.
Staging validator did not verify source IDs/provenance against the source registry context.
SupportDetails could pass with enough words while still lacking concept-specific structural depth.
QA object did not require the complete named assertion set.
Declared concept/fixation/final-question counts were not enforced.
fixesApplied: Registry-aware coverage and source checks added to validate-staged-release.mjs.
SupportDetails now requires a minimum semantic structure including example, discipline-specific checklist and microcheck/transfer.
Full QA assertion set is mandatory, including informative visual applicability, question count, history and mastery invariants.
declared_counts is mandatory and checked against actual arrays.
Published readback requires publication_pointer and checksum/session/version match.
History and mastery mutation directives are explicitly rejected.
invariants: No pedagogical session was generated or published during testing.
No learner history or progress state was modified.
